evaluation_overlap.clearance: ORCH must clear placement/shared-resource contention and preserve Main's protected jobs; directory disjointness is not an I/O-isolation proof.
evaluation_overlap.direct_slot_dependency: CP2's known evaluation contracts consume GCS numbered/stop exports, not slot A.
evaluation_overlap.shared_inputs: No bound current intersection is held for runtime/base-model/initialization archives. Shared reads and800G on GPU hosts may contend.
evaluation_overlap.writes: No existing training/evaluation input is changed; outputs must be a fresh disjoint CPU publication directory.

gates_still_open: Separate user approval and ORCH GPU order

one_job.behavior: Run the exact confirmed CPU entry; only after matching PASS run the60-second/512-MiB baseline child if at least90 seconds plus publication reserve remain.
one_job.fallback: If no wall budget remains or capture fails, preserve CPU PASS, report the baseline gap and await a separate capture order.
one_job.recommended: Use the combined command after staging/preflight and explicit authority.

paths_status.checker: Proposed destination; no026cb696 installation receipt exists.
paths_status.kit: Attested alias; no separate canonical-realpath receipt. Resolve and record it at admitted runtime.
paths_status.packet_destinations: Proposed fresh directories; staging requires separate authority.
paths_status.persistent: Held canonical address; retain the original slot.
paths_status.results_parent: Proposed, unreserved and not verified present/writable/canonical.

result_contract.baseline_failure: CPU_PASS_BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE with exit4 preserves the CPU result but leaves the baseline gate open.
result_contract.combined_success: CPU_PASS_BASELINE_READY with exit0, a pinned BASELINE.json and complete capture receipt; no GPU continuation authority.
result_contract.cpu: RESULT.json from the unchanged checker, exact slot544 and real PASS; HANDOFF.json additionally binds the expected slot and allocation.
result_contract.cpu_failure: Nonzero checker return or mismatched/failed result withholds baseline execution.
result_contract.cpu_only_success: CPU_PASS_BASELINE_PENDING with exit0; the numerical baseline remains open.
result_contract.publication_failure: A complete-looking BASELINE.json may exist if directory sync/return delivery fails. Require the successful capture receipt and process exit0; never accept the filename alone.
result_contract.retries: No automatic retry or GPU submission; any retry needs a separate order.
result_contract.source_state: The original verified slot remains the continuation input. Never use CPU-reserialized state.

scheduler.advanced: Not supported by the confirmed entry; zero-GPU admission is not established in held operator evidence.
scheduler.sbatch: Resolved through the exact held PATH; its absolute executable path has not been attested.
